instant_sources.GB: pinned ONS bulletin calendar (v5 pin aad19697); date-only evidence -> conservative end-of-day UTC
instant_sources.CA: pinned StatCan WDS calendar v3 (pin 0f1a9328); true-UTC timestamps evidenced per row (tz_conversion archived); ref month = release month - 1 (StatCan monthly convention, validated by non-negative realtime lags below)
instant_sources.AU: pinned ABS release calendar (v5 pin 42a4e4a3); date-only -> conservative end-of-day UTC; quarter-first-month representation (V9 law)
instant_sources.NZ: pinned Stats NZ calendar (v5 pin 62f82c23); 10:45 Pacific/Auckland local -> DST-correct UTC
instant_sources.US: pinned FRED realtime archive first-appearances (CADS US/fred_cpiaucsl_rt.json); date-only -> conservative end-of-day UTC

method.inclusion_rule: publication date within the measured S0 window AND the reference period carries a vintaged realized value (first-appearance realtime exists); per instant the census records publication evidence, archive first-realtime, the conservative operative availability max(publication, first_realtime), and release ordinals (CA WDS correction releases of the same month are listed but flagged)
method.dst_rule: zoneinfo local->UTC conversion; date-only evidence gets a conservative 23:59:59Z bound (a 16:00-NY same-day decision cannot see it)

calendar_pin_basis.GB: V9 P0 census GB_cal pin aad19697

announcement_ledger_emu_v2.note: announcement ledger EMU v2 repair rows (schema forex_free_v6_announcement_ledger_repair_v2_row_v1); read-only evidence lineage for the S3 announcement-ledger series (EMU rate-decision rows are not CPI print instants and are not in the GB/CA/AU/NZ/US census scope)

s0_window.end_basis: last calendar-evidenced print publication with a vintaged realized value on the non-US legs

canary.basis: fabricated: no ONS bulletin released that day
fabricated: ABS CPI is quarterly; no such release

known_gaps: AU calendar evidence starts 2019-10-30 (V9: ABS past-release pulls network-failed); pre-2019-10 AU prints have no publication-timestamp evidence and are NOT counted
US instants carry date-only evidence (FRED realtime bytes have no time-of-day): conservative end-of-day bound
CA WDS calendars list correction releases of the same reference month; all are listed with release_ordinal_in_reference_period and is_first_release_of_period flags -- the PRINT instant is ordinal 1
